What to understand at MT6

Endless mode
A test intended to continue past a normal clear. It is where large wave-record objectives become practical.
Normal completion
Finishing a region at a particular normal difficulty. It is distinct from merely unlocking the region or setting an Endless record.
Wave advancement
How quickly the wave counter moves. When enemies already die immediately, more damage may barely improve this.

What you are working toward

  • Work toward wave 1,000,000, the milestone described in the supplied tier research. Confirm it and all additional requirements in Headquarters.
  • Use the current total-module-tier threshold; do not copy the outdated total from older tables.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an editorial synthesis of the supplied community research. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Complete available wave-software research

    Inspect Headquarters for unlocked but unresearched software and improve servers where research speed is holding you back. Make sure relevant software is enabled during the intended run. Ownership alone is not enough. [S07]

  2. Increase normal-mode coverage

    Clear additional region/difficulty combinations that your tower can handle. These completions support Wave Storm. Choose manageable clears before spending a long time forcing one difficult combination. [S07] [S12]

  3. Build for rapid, reliable kills

    Use a coherent damage source with attack speed and useful multi-target effects such as Multishot, bouncing or splash. Maintain enough healing and defense that the run survives unattended stretches. An impressive burst of kills followed by a quick death is not sustained progression. [S06] [S12]

  4. Run Endless and diagnose the limiting factor

    Use Wave Momentum and appropriate researched acceleration software. Watch whether the tower is struggling to kill, struggling to survive, or simply advancing waves slowly. Those are three different problems and should lead to different purchases. [S07]

  5. Finish the milestone and remaining objectives

    Once the wave requirement is registered, return to any unfinished module collection or tier objectives. At MT7, inspect the newly available software before attempting the much larger next record. [S02] [S07]

If you are stuck

Enemies vanish but the wave number crawls

Check software research, enabled states and normal-mode completion. Raw attack upgrades are unlikely to be the first solution.

The run is fast but repeatedly dies

Add enough survival to keep the acceleration running. A slightly slower stable build can outperform repeated failed pushes.

Ready to move on?

  • Headquarters has registered the wave objective.
  • The collection and current total-tier objectives are complete.
After the promotion

MT7 adds more acceleration tools. Their interaction matters far more on the route to wave 100 billion than on your early regional clears. [S02] [S07]
